text:
Maya: Heads-up: NimbusPay renewal flagged — sudden ~75% drop in API calls over last 7d after their SSO push. Need triage asap.
Rohit: Got it. Any signal it's org-wide or just a few teams? :eyes:
Maya: Dashboard shows the activity hit is concentrated to the 'invoices' service which migrated to SSO last Thursday. Link: https://dash.redwood.local/orgs/nimbuspay/usage
Maya: Quick query I ran:
```
SELECT day, sum(api_calls) as calls
FROM usage
WHERE org='nimbuspay' AND day >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
Ethan: Invoices team used a nightly batch that hit our generate-token endpoint. If their callback changed, token exchange will 500.
Liza: I emailed their eng lead; reply: "SSO token exchange returning 500s since Friday - blocking invoice ingestion"
deploy-bot: audit: log bundle ready at s3://redwood-logs/nimbuspay/ssologs/2026-03-20.tar.gz
Rohit: I'll pull the 500 traces. @Ethan can you look at the token exchange flow? Suspect redirect_uri mismatch.
Ethan: On it. Initial look: logs show `oauth: token exchange error: invalid_grant - redirect_uri_mismatch`. Their config switched callback from `/auth/callback` -> `/auth/sso/callback`.
Maya: This is time-sensitive — renewal in 3 weeks and procurement already heard a competitor pitch that emphasized "SSO-ready" setup. Need fast remediation + fallback plan.
Ana: Sales note: if we don't stabilize they may start an RFP. Can we offer a 30-day dedicated slot + hands-on migration to keep them engaged?
Liza: Agree. Proposed action items: 1) @Ethan investigate & patch redirect mapping (ETA 4h). 2) @Rohit confirm error spike and prepare rollback to API-key mode (ETA 2h). 3) @Maya draft customer comms + offer dedicated trial + enablement session. 4) @Ana prepare concession approval. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident created CS-2026-045, priority=high, assignees=[Ethan,Rohit,Maya]
Maya: I'll schedule a 30-min sync with NimbusPay for 10:30 PT and include devs + procurement. Sharing notes into renewal doc after the call.
Ethan: Patch applied to staging; tests show successful token exchange with the corrected redirect.
Rohit: Verified 2xx exchanges on staging. Rolling hotfix to prod now, monitoring request success and error rate.
Maya: Thanks team. If usage recovers to >90% of baseline in 12h we can avoid concessions. If not, escalate procurement playbook and prepare to fast-track the dedicated offer. :pray:
